posts.body:
Does anyone have any clue where I can find a (free) animated SV mindflayer for use in MV? Like you know, the standard MV animated SV format, or even something that I can re-sort the frames of so that it matches MV's animation format? It can be original, or based on anything from MZ, MV, VX, XP, or 2000 since I own all of those. I got Guardinthena's map sprites which are just incredible but dang, I need an animated SV one. I'd be willing to pay for one if I had any money at all, like literally ANY, so if I can't find a free one, maybe I'll have to wait till I have more funds, if anyone's selling a pre-made one...I really don't want to have to commission one since it'll probably be a WHILE till I can afford that and commissioning is expensive.
But like, dang, mindflayer is a popular enemy right? Surely there must be a few versions floating around out there some where??

posts.author: Avery
posts.body:
This might sound a bit petty, but you WANT it to be animated, you don't NEED it to be animated
Your financial status has nothing to do with a resource request, neither your mental one. Both don't make a request more or less reasonable.
The type of request you want to make is this one (please write your own, this is an example):
LINK TO TEMPLATE
Guys, I am deeply in love with
Guardinthena's Mindflayer sprites
and would love it, if I could use them in battle. Since I want them to be on the heroes' side/use animated monsters, it would be amazing if someone could change the head on the default template to one resembling of the one that her sprite has? Don't worry about the clothing or color, I can edit that on my own and slap something from the generator on him if I need him dressed. I would be forever grateful!
Resource Type:
SV Battler
Maker Format:
MV or MZ
Makers I Own:
2k3,XP,VX,MV, MZ
Art Style:
RTP
Description:
Basically, I need mindflayer template for an SV battler that goes with the linked sprite, just the head alone might even be easier for me to edit it in above clothing.
Reference Images:
Guardinthena's Mindflayer sprites
Click to expand...
Then either someone helps you (as they have everything clealy laid out and explained, just the head is much less work than kinda guessing what your request entails in detail).
A note: SV battlers are TONS of work. And dragons, which are even more popular than mindflayers, barely have any coverage here, because the amount of time and skill that goes into one of these is immense. People doing commissions already charge on the lower end of things here to help others out. Never expect an SV battler to just exist, those are one of the rarest resource types due to what goes in them.
And as said, it is a WANT, not a NEED. You could also just use sprites in battles. Not as flashy, but it works!

Oh god. Avery, I'm hesitant to disagree with you...hell I'm hesitant to even respond to you. You have no idea how much I respect you, or how heavily my own project relies on things that you have created. But...if you put it that way, then, we don't need any of this stuff, you know? It's a video game. No one NEEDS it. And besides which, there are 80 million still graphics out there, I could use any one of them. Or, I could just write "mindflayer" on a blank square and stick it in the game lol.
But I've built up a modest collection of animated battlers over the years and now I think I finally have enough to make my game the way that I want it, and the mindflayer was just a small ask, and if I don't have it, then so be it. I just won't have a mindflayer. Because like...I'm not gonna have all my enemies be animated except for that one, lol, that would be tacky and bizarre. So really, that's what I don't need, is a mindflayer. And I don't. I can make my game work without it. I was just asking, you know, maybe someone had seen one out there somewhere, that's all.
But, I thank you for the advice on how to make a request in the future. I wasn't really trying to be all formal with it, as, like I said, I'll be fine without it, and I was really just...wondering if someone had seen one out there somewhere. But going forward I'll keep it in mind in the future. Thank you.
EDIT: let me me rephrase something, because I feel like you'll see where I wrote "the mindflayer was just a small ask" and say something about how it's NOT a small ask and it's a lot of work and everything. Again, I wasn't asking anyone to make one for me, I was just wondering if anyone had seen one. And I was just off-handedly wondering. I'm not asking anyone to go to any trouble for me. Which is why this is not the place I originally posted this, resource requests, as I wasn't really "requesting" it. I didn't want anyone to think I was asking that. My post got moved here by a mod.
EDIT 2: Okay I know I'm probably over-explaining myself because I'm nervous but I'd rather be seen as a nervous bumbling fool than a jerk so anyway: like you know, normally I wouldn't even ask, because I don't want to make requests for just myself, I'm happy to just use what other people have posted out there for free. Like your stuff. Which is why I respect you so much. Which is why I'm nervous and over-explaining myself. The only reason I even posted anything at all is because I already had those super cool sprites that Guardinthena made and loved them so much as villains, and I have all these animated battlers and I can't go back to using static ones for one fight, especially not for a boss fight for a character that I love so much. It would just be...I don't know. This is why I don't post here. Because I'm always misunderstood when I say things in text and aaaaall these people I respect and admire will see what I write and think I'm a jerk and then I have to over explain myself and now they'll think I'm an idiot instead, it's a lose lose. God. Okay I'm done.
